yt_title: Google your own name. Then do these 3 free things
caption:
POV: you Google your own name.

Three free fixes from a saved reel:
1. Have I Been Pwned: check if your email was in a data breach, then change those passwords
2. JustDeleteMe: direct links to delete old accounts
3. Google's Results about you: ask Google to remove search results showing your phone, address or email (available in many countries)

Ask Claude to draft the deletion requests for you.

Sorted by SaveSort. Sort your saves free, link in bio.

#privacy #cybersecurity #techtips #savedreels
